title: SKIjack: a supercombinator language over SKI combinatory logic
description: SKIjack is a supercombinator language over the S, K, I combinatory logic, with a reference implementation in Python. Programs are equations grouped into cores and compiled by bracket abstraction to closed terms over {S, K, I}. The surface has one grammar with two lexicons, ASCII and Unicode. Quotation is a compile-time construct, and a two-stage checker keeps provable functions out of data positions. The repository holds the language specification (SPEC.md), the design notes, the reference compiler and checker, and a corpus written in both spellings that also serves as the conformance suite for the Avon C runtime. It accompanies N. E. Davis, "SKIjack: A Low-Level Native Language for the SKI Calculus" (in review).
